title.es: El de cuando Fina no la delata
title.en: The One Where Fina Won't Give Her Away

description.es: Marta y Digna hablan sobre la detención de Fina. Marta dice que Fina es todo para ella y que la quiere muchísimo. Marta se entera de que fue Santiago quien denunció a Fina. Le ofrece dinero para que retire la denuncia, pero Santiago no lo acepta. Marta visita a Fina. Fina le dice a Marta que la quiere muchísimo y que, hagan lo que hagan, no la delatará.
description.en: Marta and Digna talk about Fina's arrest. Marta says that Fina is her everything and that she loves her very much. Marta learns that it was Santiago who reported Fina. She offers him money to withdraw his complaint, but Santiago does not accept it. Marta visits Fina. Fina tells Marta that she loves her very much and that, whatever they do, she will not give her away.
